_doc: YOUR house-hunt criteria. Copy this to criteria.json and fill it in. 'hard' = must-haves (pass = a real match). 'relax' = how far a listing may bend a hard rule and still land in the 'close enough' bucket. 'dealbreakers' = exclude entirely, no matter the score.

relax._doc: A listing that FAILS a hard rule but only within these tolerances becomes 'close enough' (with a reason shown). Bigger misses are excluded.
